meta.title: storcon: skip offline nodes in get_top_tenant_shards
meta.body_summary: Skip offline nodes in the storage controller's get_top_tenant_shards to avoid optimizer background loop delays caused by waiting for timeouts when nodes are unreachable.

perf_labels.notes: Devin fixed storcon timeout by filtering offline nodes; reviewed and merged within ~1.2h with no objections.

core_change_summary.description: In storage_controller/src/service.rs, added a filter to skip nodes that are offline before making API calls in get_top_tenant_shards, thereby eliminating timeout delays from inaccessible nodes.
change_trajectory: Single commit introduced the filter: 4 additions, 2 deletions in service.rs.
